# BRIEF

## User-Facing Goal

Present the Web Page/Digital Menu at EUR 12 monthly or EUR 120 annually everywhere current customers can see repository-controlled pricing.

## Success Criteria

- Pricing page shows EUR 12 monthly and EUR 120 annually.
- README product pricing matches the page.
- Image Menu remains EUR 7 monthly and EUR 70 annually.

## UX Notes

No layout or copy changes are required beyond the amounts.

## Risks Or Tradeoffs

Polar's external Plus products must be updated before checkout is re-enabled or checkout could charge the old amount.
